sloka: स ताभ्यां पूजितः पूज्यः कपिभिश्च प्रसादितः ।दृष्टा सीतेति विक्रान्तः संक्षेपेण न्यवेदयत् ।। 5.57.35 ।।।।
transliteration: sa tābhyāṁ pūjitaḥ pūjyaḥ kapibhiśca prasāditaḥ ।dṛṣṭā sīteti vikrāntaḥ saṁkṣepeṇa nyavedayat ।। 5.57.35 ।।।।

translations.english: The valiant Hanuman worthy of worship having been honoured by both Jambavan and Angada was pleased. He responded briefly, saying 'Saw Sita'.
